title: Vectorial lattice Boltzmann solver for compressible inviscid flows with generic equation of state
summary: We develop a vectorial lattice Boltzmann model with a space-time adaptive relaxation coefficient, combined with adaptive time-stepping for compressible Euler dynamics with generic equation of state. The model, due to special form of the relaxation coefficient devised here is shown to converge to the Euler limit with second-order accuracy in the absence of shocks under acoustic scaling. The solver is robust and able to properly capture compressible gas dynamics for both ideal and non-ideal equations of state, including the Bethe--Zel'dovich--Thompson regime.
